# Hugo Narrow 2.1.0

Minor release for Hugo Narrow 2.0. It reworks search, image delivery, the article context bar, and the way comments and analytics load.

## Highlights

- Search now uses MiniSearch, so Chinese, Japanese, and other languages without word spacing are matched by word. Disabling search removes the dock button and the script, and the generated index is empty.
- Responsive images derive their width ladder from `contentWidth` instead of fixed breakpoints. JPEG and PNG sources also get WebP variants, controlled by `params.image.webp` and `params.image.quality`.
- On article pages, the context bar hides while scrolling down, returns as a title-only capsule while scrolling up, and expands smoothly back into the original breadcrumb when clicked or tapped. Other page kinds keep the static breadcrumb.
- Every gallery layout option (`gap`, `columns`, `targetRowHeight`, `lastRowBehavior`, `columnWidth`) can now be set in `params.gallery` and overridden per page. The layout switcher is a single cycling button.
- Tabs show their first panel when JavaScript is disabled.
- Safe-area insets are respected on notched devices, and controls get larger tap targets on coarse pointers: dock items, series steps, the gallery switcher, search clear, and the announcement close button.
- CI now checks formatting, that `compiled.css` matches its sources, and that the example site builds, on pushes to `main` and on pull requests.

## Breaking changes

### Comments

- `comments.system` is renamed to `comments.provider`. Update site params and any page-level `comments` front matter.
- giscus now requires `repo`, `repoId`, and `categoryId` together. A provider with missing required keys shows the existing "not configured" notice instead of loading an empty embed.
- Unknown providers log a suppressible warning and show the same notice.

### Hugo Modules

- The Go module path is `github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/v2`. Sites that imported the path without `/v2` must update `module.imports` and run `hugo mod tidy`.

## Fixes

- Analytics providers only render when their required keys are set: `id` for google, baidu, and clarity; `id` and `src` for umami. Missing keys log a build warning instead of emitting a script with an empty ID.
- Disabling search no longer breaks the build; `index.json` returns an empty array when search is off.
- The gallery layout button now announces the active layout through `aria-label`.
- Twikoo no longer flashes the wrong theme on first load.

## Localization

- Added Bengali (`bn`).

## Compatibility

No other configuration changes are required. See the [2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for the v1 migration list.
